_comment: Maps lexicon entry ids to geocoding place ids for places the automatic proper-noun matcher cannot link. Place ids come from data/generated/geocoding-index.json (or the upstream ancient.jsonl 'id' field). See scripts/import-geocoding.ts.
_rationale_asshur: BDB glosses אַשּׁוּר 'Asshur'; upstream names the region 'Assyria'. Rejected by the spelling gate, correct as a scholarly equivalence.
_rationale_zion: Zion / City of David / Jerusalem denote one site; link each lexicon entry to all three place records.
